intro: Tooga, a lost turtle, was sent out to fetch dinner by his wife Torta and took a wrong turn somewhere. Tooga asks you to lead him back to Torta, who waits just south of Steamwheedle Port.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My wife, Torta, sent me out to fetch dinner and I must have taken a wrong turn somewhere.
Would you be so kind as to lead me back to Torta? She's waiting for me just south of Steamwheedle Port.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So he couldn't find his way back on his own? Figures.
Well, I guess you deserve something for your troubles....
